cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Let's pack your paintings for the last gallery. You've finally picked up a brush again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If the big gallery rejected me too, I'm done. Did they write?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Their letter can wait. This gallery still needs your best three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pick them, then. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the envelopes. You finish the blue one; there's still somewhere for it to go.

mechanism: A controls access to gallery correspondence and assigns finishing work to keep an artist painting despite a feared discouraging reply.
confusable: D103 invites shared hope openly; D111 hides discouraging information because hope is thought necessary for continued action.
comparison: A guarded gallery letter differs from a covered waiting-list number and a room offered for seedlings.
seedUse: Retain D111-a letter delay and B requested selection producing controlled envelope handling plus a specific painting task.
